_: What this repository's gate reads and builds. No census of the files its suite opens has been taken here, so `reads` claims every tracked file (`**`): nothing is gate-inert, the same conservative reading the repository had with no record. `builds` names what the gate (run.ps1 -Gate: its two Fable stages compile the playground and the showcase app (scripts/fable-app.mjs) and the parity render host (pnpm run fable); run.ps1 without -Gate is the dev launcher) builds, and `notBuilt` each project file it deliberately does not, with the reason. Checked: the coverage check classifies every tracked project file against the pair, and once `builds` is declared an unreached project is an error and refuses a landing.
